selection_rule: Advance cycle_exit unchanged if both dev mean placement deltas <= +0.15, at least 50% fewer moves, and no invalid/incomplete games. Otherwise retain as negative experiment; do not tune using holdout. Cap7 is preexisting control only, not a selectable winner.
acceptance_rule: Operational improvement only if >=50% fewer moves and zero illegal/incomplete games on both held-out profiles; strength improvement only if both paired whole-seed 95% CIs upper bound <0. Noninferiority only if both upper bounds <+0.15. Otherwise explicitly inconclusive/tradeoff; frozen v0.2 remains default.
caveats: Smoke dev20000 only proves execution, not selection
